headline: Bandhan Bank receives SEBI disclosure on acquisition of healthcare entities
sum: Quadramedical Research and Foundation, along with Quadra Hospital & Medical Services and Gamma Spect Imaging entities, disclosed stake acquisition intent to Bandhan Bank under SEBI Takeover Regulations. The disclosure filings indicate potential acquisition activity by or involving these healthcare entities in relation to the listed bank.
detail: Quadramedical Research and Foundation Pvt. Ltd., operating through subsidiary entities Quadra Hospital & Medical Services Pvt. Ltd. and Gamma Spect Imaging & Diagnostic Centre Pvt. Ltd., made formal disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations. The filing was submitted to NSE on 7 July 2026. The exact acquisition structure-whether direct stake purchase in Bandhan Bank or debt-to-equity conversion-and quantum of stake acquired or intended are not specified in the disclosure headline. This appears to be a preliminary or ongoing disclosure notification rather than a completed transaction announcement.
